desc: Implement coordinate compression and two Binary Indexed Trees (one for counts, one for sums) to support efficient sliding window median queries.
Compute the cost for each window of size `x` by finding the median rank via binary search on the BIT and applying the absolute deviation formula.
Initialize a DP table of size `(n+1) x (k+1)` with infinity, setting `dp[0][0] = 0`.
Fill the DP table by iterating through each position, updating `dp[i][j]` using the minimum of skipping the current position or taking a valid subarray ending at `i-1`.
Return `dp[k][m]` as the minimum operations required.
